title: 第25章 靖安校尉第26章 血战恩义
slug: 看见血条的我选择打爆世界
content_zh:
周元升职了，从射声什长升到了神臂队正。
一次秘境探索让他走到了士卒的顶端，再下一步就该是赐官身、晋都伯军职了。
军司马蔡诚是一个称职的领队，不仅当作肉坦冲在最前面，休整时还会合理分配军功。
不过他也有自身的评估倾向，明显更偏向玄甲队一点。
但神臂队的成员、包括周元，都不能说蔡诚以权谋私，照顾嫡系下属。
因为七名伤势不一的玄甲士，正在药堂接受军医治疗。
他们有的手臂骨裂、有的皮肉刀伤，其中一位举盾硬抗妖魔寨主重击的勇士，更是手腕肿胀、小臂骨折。
幸好秘境出产的金疮药有奇效，不然这些玄甲伤员很难快速恢复战斗力。
军司马蔡诚作为玄甲队的直属领导，并没有第一时间上前慰问，反而站在库房一侧仿佛在等什么人。
周元远远望去，果然在府中长廊处看到了一位身着将甲、外罩黑色大氅的威严将军。
那将军仿佛觉察到了周元的注视，冰冷的脸上挤出一丝笑容，并微微颔首示意。
“周元，莫对校尉大人不敬，他是气贯周身的武者，感知能力远超你我这等凡俗。
你们射手的眼神太毒，别惹的校尉大人误解。”
“受教了，军司马要等校尉大人慰问完，再去安抚玄甲士吗？”
“你倒是机敏，却该如此，校尉大人是武者，神臂玄甲血战以供灵食，于情于理校尉大人都该亲自慰问。
我去的早晚不重要，我最多安抚他们的情绪，校尉大人却能给他们实打实的好处。”
军司马蔡诚说没错，营中最高长官出现后，受伤的玄甲士欢欣振奋。
靖安校尉也非常体恤下属，大手一挥轻伤者休假十五天，重伤者带薪放假两月。
那手臂骨折的汉子当即拜倒，请求回城陪伴妻儿。
结果不用说，自然是得到了允许，稳定伤势后便可乘军需处的马车回城静养了。

靖安校尉慰问完后，又对着库房的方向点了点头，才在亲兵的陪同下离去。
等到那位高大威武的校尉离开后，周元才疑惑的发问。
“军司马，校尉大人既然是厉害的武者，为何不亲自攻伐秘境？”
“周元，武者气贯周身，一举一动皆有灵气加持。
校尉大人攻伐秘境自然简单，但损耗的灵气也需要秘境灵物补充。”
“我们靖安军不是士族门阀，秘境所产灵物是要定期定量上交朝廷的。
所剩灵物还需供给校尉大人修炼和战时储备，如何能用于攻伐补气。”
蔡诚的解释让周元明白，超凡武者不能自生灵气，他们每次战斗后都需要补气。
灵物产出充足的势力也就罢了，灵物产出有限的地区，还真用不起这些吞金巨兽。
比如靖安军明明有一位武者校尉坐镇，但却无法轻易动用这份强大战力。
“随我来，我去安抚士卒，你跟着露露脸。
等兄弟们知晓你有袍泽之意后，便找文书申请新居所吧。”
在军司马蔡诚的带领下，周元看望了受伤的玄甲士卒。
期间收获了不少夸赞，皆说等恢复了要再次并肩作战。
看得出来，玄甲士对好射手的需求很高。
content_en:
Zhou Yuan was promoted, from Archer Commander to Chief of the Divine Arm Team.
An exploration of a secret realm brought him to the top of the ranks of the soldiers, and the next step was to be given an official status and the rank of Du Bo.
Military Commander Ma Caicheng is a competent team leader. He not only rushes to the front as a tank, but also distributes military merits reasonably during rest periods.
However, he also has his own evaluation tendency, and he is obviously more biased towards the Xuanjia team.
But none of the members of the Divine Arm Team, including Zhou Yuan, could say that Cai Cheng used power for personal gain and took care of his direct subordinates.
Because seven Xuanjia soldiers with different injuries were receiving treatment from military doctors in the medicine hall.
Some of their arms had broken bones and some had wounds on their flesh. One of the warriors who held up a shield to resist the heavy attack of the demon village leader had a swollen wrist and a broken forearm.
Fortunately, the golden sore medicine produced in the secret realm has miraculous effects, otherwise it would be difficult for these wounded Xuanjia soldiers to quickly recover their combat effectiveness.
Military Commander Ma Caicheng, as the direct leader of the Xuanjia Team, did not immediately come forward to offer condolences. Instead, he stood on the side of the warehouse as if waiting for someone.
Zhou Yuan looked from a distance and saw a majestic general wearing general armor and a black cloak in the corridor of the mansion.
The general seemed to be aware of Zhou Yuan's gaze, a smile appeared on his cold face, and he nodded slightly.
"Zhou Yuan, don't be disrespectful to the captain. He is a warrior with Qi throughout his body, and his perceptual abilities are far beyond ordinary people like you and me.
The eyes of your shooters are too poisonous, don’t misunderstand me, Captain. "
"I've been taught a lesson. Do you want Army Sima to wait until the Colonel has finished his condolences before going to comfort Master Xuanjia?"
"You are smart, but that's how it should be. The Colonel is a warrior, and he fights bloody battles with his divine arm and black armor for spiritual food. He should express his condolences in person, both emotionally and rationally.
It doesn't matter whether I go sooner or later. I can at most appease their emotions, but the Captain can give them real benefits. "
Military Commander Ma Caicheng said it was right. After the highest officer in the camp appeared, the injured Xuanjia was delighted.
Captain Jing'an was also very considerate of his subordinates, giving those with minor injuries a fifteen-day leave and those with serious injuries two months' paid leave.
The man with a broken arm immediately prostrated himself and asked to return to the city to be with his wife and children.
Needless to say, the result was naturally granted. After stabilizing the injury, he could take the carriage from the Military Supplies Department back to the city to rest.
After Captain Jing'an finished expressing his condolences, he nodded in the direction of the warehouse before leaving accompanied by his own soldiers.
After the tall and mighty captain left, Zhou Yuan asked in confusion.
"Military Sima, since the captain is a powerful warrior, why don't you attack the secret realm yourself?"
"Zhou Yuan, the martial artist's Qi runs throughout his body, and every move he makes is blessed by spiritual energy.
It is naturally easy for Master Xiaowei to attack the secret realm, but the lost spiritual energy also needs to be replenished by the secret realm spiritual objects. "
"Our Jing'an Army is not a noble clan, and the spiritual objects produced in the secret realm must be handed over to the court in a regular and quantitative amount.
The remaining spiritual objects still need to be provided to the captain for training and wartime reserves, so how can they be used for attacking and replenishing energy. "
Cai Cheng's explanation made Zhou Yuan understand that extraordinary warriors cannot generate spiritual energy on their own, and they need to replenish their energy after every battle.
It's just enough power to produce enough spiritual things. Areas with limited spiritual things can't really afford these gold-swallowing behemoths.
For example, the Jing'an Army clearly has a warrior captain in charge, but it cannot easily use this powerful combat power.
"Come with me, I will comfort the soldiers, and you can show your face.
After the brothers know that you are interested in paoze, you can find documents to apply for a new residence. "
Under the leadership of Army Commander Ma Cai Cheng, Zhou Yuan visited the injured Xuanjia soldiers.
During this period, I received a lot of compliments, and they all said that they would fight together again when they recover.
It can be seen that Xuan Jiashi has a high demand for good shooters.
